chapter: Second session: boyhood, brothers and early road years
title: Johnny's writing guide for the blind
summary: Johnny's only inventions were the Meat Market idea and a writing guide that let blind people write straight lines.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up under segregation: schools, neighborhoods, Jim Crow

blocks.x: You were walking away from the microphone when you mentioned Johnny's invention for...
I said he had a lot of ideas but he never done anything with them. The only thing that Johnny invented was the idea of the Meat Market and the machine--reading for the blind.
But I don't think we talked about that on the tape. You told me about that off the tape. You want to describe that reading machine...
Yeah. Well, he had a machine that...uh, it...uh, say you...you had your...uh, what do you call those things that you write on? You know, your little plate, like?
I don't know what you mean. Slate?
Yeah. You know what I mean. You got 'em in the size of just the size of your sheet of paper, and they...micro-board, I guess you'd call it. I got some here. Let's see...
Yeah, where you...where you uh...yeah, this is one. See? This is one. You know what I'm talking about. And you stick your paper in there, you see?
Yeah, sure. Mmmmmhmmm, through the clipboard.

And on his machine, you'd put your little...uh, outlay...on top of that, and it had spaces across, and you got a button there, you push it down to the second line and you write. It's not for anybody that don't know how to write. See, say you
lost your eyes now, and you couldn't see how to write, but you get this machine, and you can write Los Angeles, California on there, then you move it down...

A writing guide. And you just keep on moving it down like you want it. And then you get down there where you want to sign your name, you put it there and you pull the button over so far so you can't write further than this and you write your name there in that space and up here the same way. You put Los Angeles, California, so-and-so, then you pull that back, and you commence your lines.
